serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: Ouch! {{wi}} Why did you hit me?!
Policewoman: Stop power tripping, we need to go.
Policeman: Where?!
Policewoman: Didn’t you hear on the radio? 10-56 in progress. 
#Policeman.Face.normal
Policeman: Again? That’s like the 3rd today. I can’t catch a break!
Policewoman: You wasted your break talking to these people.
Policewoman: Sorry for my partner today, he didn’t mean harm. He was joking. {{wi}}I think.
Policeman: Yeah, yeah, let’s just go. Where did you leave the car?
Policewoman: A few blocks away.
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: W-what?! Couldn’t you just drive up to me?
Policewoman: Shut up, you could use some exercise.
Policeman: Oh really? You say that now, but later you will complain about how my sweat smells, right?!
#Policewoman.Face.annoyed
Policewoman: That’s a separate issue…
